name: Zhipu GLM
note: Quota only, and the same GLM coding plan Z.ai sells internationally — Zhipu is the brand it carries on open.bigmodel.cn. One product, two hosts, and a descriptor states one endpoint, so this is the second descriptor rather than a second endpoint in the first. The two can never both report: each carries a `requires` guard naming its own base, and `env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` in ~/.claude/settings.json holds exactly one of them. Without that exclusivity this would double-count a single plan, which is worse than missing it. The shape is published nowhere; checked 2026-09-27, docs.z.ai documents the plan and not this call, and open.bigmodel.cn publishes no reference for it either. It is mapped from the only primary source there is, ClaudeBar's ZaiUsageProbe, cross-read 2026-09-27: it recognises api.z.ai, open.bigmodel.cn and dev.bigmodel.cn, chooses between them by what that variable contains, and builds the identical /api/monitor/usage/quota/limit path onto each. So the response shape is the one the zai descriptor already maps and this file repeats it field for field rather than paraphrasing it — a second reading of the same reply would be a second chance to get it wrong. The window keys are type and unit together, because two limits differing only by unit collapse into one otherwise and the bar draws a window under another's label. dev.bigmodel.cn is the third base that probe knows and is not declared here: the guard names open.bigmodel.cn exactly, so a development base reads as not signed in rather than being charted against the wrong host. Narrowing it to `bigmodel.cn` would catch both and send a dev account's key to the production host, which is the trade the zai note argues against in the other direction. verified is false: the figures have never been read against a live Zhipu plan, and the fixture is the whole of the check.

compatibility.note: Mapping repeats the Z.ai descriptor field for field against the same response shape; neither the numbers nor this host have been confirmed against a live plan.

quota.setupHint: Point Claude Code at Zhipu and sign in.
